readme: Recipe-ingredient ad-matching rules for compare-deals -CommoditiesFile. Wrapper form: global_exclude relaxes sauce/canned/frozen/juice (recipe items legitimately are those); each rule carries inline band_min/band_max.

commodities.label: 93/7 Ground Turkey
commodities.note: Targets the lean (93/7 or leaner) ground turkey specifically so it never captures fattier 85/15 or the generic ground-turkey staple; excludes turkey sausage/patties/meatballs.

commodities.label: Apple Cider
commodities.note: Brad 2026-08-23: STILL cider only, not sparkling. No custom exclude is needed - 'sparkling' is already in global_exclude, and this entry is what subjects the commodity to it. The recipe using this braises pork in 12 oz, where carbonation is beside the point and Martinelli's costs several times more per fl oz. No band: this commodity has no priced rows to derive one from, and inventing a price gate is not what this ruling was.

commodities.label: Au Jus Gravy Mix
commodities.note: Dry au jus gravy mix, the ~1 oz packet. Relaxes the mix token (every one is named 'Gravy Mix') and the dip token ('French Dip Au Jus Gravy Mix' is the same packet). Excludes ready-made roasts and sandwiches sold 'au jus'. Minted 2026-09-19: no staple or recipe id prices au jus (brown-gravy-mix is a different gravy).

commodities.label: Beef Base
commodities.note: Concentrated beef base / bouillon paste (Better Than Bouillon, Member's Mark Beef Base, Knorr paste). Cubes and granules are a different product and are excluded. Minted 2026-09-19: staple bouillon mixes chicken granules with beef base, so its cheapest cell is not this purchase.

commodities.label: Boneless Beef Short Ribs
commodities.note: Raw boneless beef short ribs, per lb. Bone-in short ribs (staple beef-short-ribs' shape) are a different purchase. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Boneless Skinless Chicken Thigh
commodities.note: Requires boneless+skinless so it does not grab cheaper bone-in thighs/legs covered by the existing chicken-thighs staple; pricier cut so band floor is higher.

commodities.label: Buffalo Wing Sauce
commodities.note: Buffalo wing sauce. The include skips the brand words 'Buffalo Wild Wings' so that brand's non-buffalo flavours (Asian Zing, Honey BBQ, Parmesan Garlic) never match on the brand, while its Medium Buffalo Sauce still does on its own second 'buffalo'. Minted 2026-09-19: staple hot-sauce is a different condiment.

commodities.label: Butter
commodities.note: Reuses the proven staple butter include/exclude, rebanded to per-oz (real butter ~$0.12-0.50/oz incl. premium).

commodities.label: 1/3 Fat Cream Cheese
commodities.note: Requires a reduced-fat/Neufchatel signal so it does not steal full-fat cream cheese from the generic staple; excludes fat-free (different product) and flavored/whipped tubs.

commodities.label: Canned Sweet Corn
commodities.note: One standard ~15.25 oz can of whole kernel corn, priced per CAN (each) because the recipe costs it per drained can. weight_is_one_unit prices a '15.25 oz' row as one can; min_piece_oz/max_pack_oz keep it to the standard can so a 29 oz or 106 oz can is never priced as 'one can'. Kept separate from staple canned-corn (per oz) on purpose: recipe-floor-id-map.json round 3 records the drained-can calibration issue that makes a map unsafe. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Capers
commodities.note: Jarred capers in brine. Minted 2026-09-19: no other id prices capers.

commodities.label: Celery Salt
commodities.note: Celery salt spice. Minted 2026-09-19: the salt staples (salt, sea-salt, kosher-salt) are plain salt.

commodities.label: Colby Jack Cheese
commodities.note: Shredded colby jack (colby and monterey jack). Every snapshot cell was shredded; the block is a different purchase. Excludes Mexican/taco blends, which carry colby jack among four cheeses. Minted 2026-09-19: staple shredded-cheese is ANY shredded cheese, so its cheapest cell is not this purchase.

commodities.label: Condensed French Onion Soup
commodities.note: One 10.5 oz can of condensed French onion soup, priced per can (each). weight_is_one_unit prices a '10.5 oz' row as one can; the piece and pack bounds keep it to the condensed can. Relaxes the soup token for this entry only. Minted 2026-09-19: staple onion-soup-mix is the dry mix.

commodities.label: Corn Tortillas
commodities.note: Corn tortillas, per tortilla. Minted 2026-09-19: staple tortillas is flour (recipe-floor-id-map round 3 rejected the map).

commodities.label: Dried Rosemary
commodities.note: Dried rosemary leaves (whole or crushed). The include requires a dried-form word (leaves, dried, crushed, ground, whole, spice) because a bare 'Rosemary' at Baker's is the FRESH produce clamshell (its store category reads Produce). Minted 2026-09-19: staple fresh-rosemary is the fresh herb.

commodities.label: Fajita Seasoning Packet
commodities.note: Fajita seasoning, the single-use packet (~1-1.5 oz), priced per packet. max_pack_oz 2 keeps a bulk canister (Bolner's 30 oz, Lawry's 8.9 oz) off the packet cell, the taco-seasoning 'packet means packet' ruling. Relaxes the mix token: every packet is named 'Seasoning Mix'. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Fat-Free Cheddar Cheese
commodities.note: Fat-free cheddar (shredded in every capture). cheddar-cheese-shredded and reduced-fat-cheddar both exclude fat free, so this entry owns them. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Fat Free Mozzarella
commodities.note: Fat-free shredded mozzarella. Minted 2026-09-19; mozzarella-cheese and reduced-fat-mozzarella exclude fat free.

commodities.label: Frozen Broccoli Florets
commodities.note: Frozen broccoli FLORETS (the name must say frozen or steam). Florets, not cuts: recipe-floor-id-map round 2 rejected frozen-broccoli because that board's cheapest rows are cuts. Fresh florets are a different purchase. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Frozen Cut Green Beans
commodities.note: Frozen cut green beans (the name must say frozen or steam; 'Fresh Frozen' and Hy-Vee's 'Fresh Steam' are frozen). green-beans (the canned entry) now excludes frozen and steam so it cannot take these first. Minted 2026-09-19: staple has fresh and canned green beans only.

commodities.label: Apple
commodities.note: Fresh apple sold per-each; \bapple word-boundary avoids matching inside pineapple, and honeycrisp kept via explicit token (bare 'crisp' avoided to not break honeycrisp).

commodities.label: Balsamic Vinegar
commodities.note: 'balsamic' token is distinctive; excludes glaze/reduction (sweetened, pricier per-oz) and salad-dressing/vinaigrette forms.

commodities.label: Bread Crumbs
commodities.note: Includes panko (a breadcrumb); excludes stuffing mix and breaded/coated meats.

commodities.label: Brown Sugar
commodities.note: Plain brown sugar ~$0.06-0.09/oz; excludes sugar substitutes and brown-sugar-cinnamon oatmeal/pop-tart/glaze look-alikes.

commodities.label: Cannellini Beans
commodities.note: White kidney bean is the literal alias for cannellini; canned/soup/dip forms already stripped by GLOBAL_EXCLUDE, so only dried/hummus/chili added.

commodities.label: Carrots
commodities.note: Fresh carrots (baby carrots allowed); excludes carrot cake/muffin/raisin; frozen/canned/juice handled globally.

commodities.label: Cashews
commodities.note: Plain/roasted cashews (nut) per oz. Excludes cashew butter, cashew milk, cashew chicken (prepared), candy clusters/brittle. Roasted/salted cashews are still the commodity, so 'roasted' is intentionally NOT excluded.

commodities.label: Cheddar Cheese, Shredded
include: Milk, so the percent-less spelling was slipping a reduced-fat product into the full-fat id
commodities.note: Requires BOTH 'cheddar' and 'shred' in either order. Place this rule BEFORE the generic 'shredded-cheese' staple so specific cheddar wins the first-match; otherwise the generic one will absorb it.

commodities.label: Ground Mustard
commodities.note: Ground mustard, the dry spice (mustard powder). Excludes stone-ground and coarse PREPARED mustards, which the words 'ground mustard' also name. Minted 2026-09-19: staple mustard is the yellow condiment.

commodities.label: Gruyere Cheese
commodities.note: Plain Gruyere, block or wedge. Staple gruyere is not this purchase: its cells on the 2026-09-17 board are SHREDDED and include cheddar-gouda-gruyere and Swiss-gruyere blends. Excludes blends, smoked Gruyere and shreds. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Hot Honey
commodities.note: Chili-infused honey, the bottle. min_pack_oz 9 keeps 1.55 oz mini jars, single-serve packets and 6-8.25 oz flavoured snacks off the cell (the smallest real bottle seen is Local Hive 9 oz). Southern Grove is excluded by name because it is Aldi's nut line: its Hot Honey is a can of nuts and the name says nothing else. The recipe honey entry now excludes hot honey so it cannot take these first. Minted 2026-09-19: staple honey is plain honey.

commodities.label: Hot Italian Sausage
commodities.note: Raw hot (spicy) Italian pork sausage, links or bulk ground. Staple italian-sausage mixes mild and sweet rows (its Baker's cell on 2026-09-17 is Sweet Italian), so it is not this purchase. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Jerk Seasoning
commodities.note: Jerk seasoning, dry blend or the wet seasoning paste the Jamaican brands sell under the same name. Excludes jerk marinades and sauces. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Liquid Smoke
commodities.note: Liquid smoke flavoring. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Mexican Cheese Blend
commodities.note: Shredded Mexican-style cheese blend (the four-cheese / fiesta blend). Excludes reduced-fat, taco-seasoned blends and single Mexican cheeses (cotija, queso quesadilla). Minted 2026-09-19: staple shredded-cheese is any shredded cheese.

commodities.label: Monterey Jack Cheese
commodities.note: Plain monterey jack, block. Every snapshot cell was a block; shredded and sliced are different purchases. Minted 2026-09-19: staple block-cheese is any block cheese.

commodities.label: Mozzarella Cheese
commodities.note: Shredded mozzarella (low-moisture, part-skim or whole milk). Every snapshot cell was shredded. Excludes the reduced-fat and fat-free forms, which have their own entries, and Italian blends. Minted 2026-09-19: staple shredded-cheese is any shredded cheese (its Aldi cell is cheddar).

commodities.label: Pepper Jack Cheese
commodities.note: Pepper jack, block. Every snapshot cell was a block. Minted 2026-09-19: staple block-cheese is any block cheese.

commodities.label: Pork Loin
commodities.note: Boneless pork loin, whole, half or roast, per lb. Bone-in loin, chops, slices and tenderloin are different purchases (staple pork-tenderloin and pork-chops). Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Reduced Fat Cheddar Cheese
exclude: milk is a gallon of milk
milk is a gallon of milk

commodities.label: Chickpeas
commodities.note: Canned/dried chickpeas per oz. Excludes Banza-style chickpea pasta, chickpea flour, roasted chickpea snacks/puffs, hummus. GLOBAL_EXCLUDE '\bcanned\b'/'\bsnack\b' rarely fires since ad text usually reads 'Bush's Garbanzo Beans 15.5 oz'.

commodities.label: Cornstarch
commodities.note: Baking cornstarch per oz (e.g. Argo 16 oz). Excludes cosmetic/baby-powder cornstarch products.

commodities.label: Crushed Tomatoes
commodities.note: Include is specific enough that paste/diced/sauce/whole won't match. GLOBAL_EXCLUDE '\bcanned\b'/'\bsauce\b'/'\bsoup\b' can pre-drop it if the ad literally says 'canned' - usually reads 'Hunt's Crushed Tomatoes 28 oz', so low risk.

commodities.label: Curry Powder
commodities.note: Include requires 'powder'/'seasoning' so bare 'curry sauce'/'curry chicken' prepared items don't match. Band is wide because small spice jars run high per oz (a 0.9 oz jar at $5 = ~$5.5/oz is real); 10x parse errors still caught.

commodities.label: Dijon Mustard
commodities.note: MUST exclude 'honey' so it does not steal the separate honey-dijon-mustard commodity. Also rejects dijon dressings/vinaigrettes/dijonnaise.

commodities.label: Enchilada Sauce
commodities.note: CONFLICT: GLOBAL_EXCLUDE contains '\bsauce\b', which will pre-drop EVERY enchilada sauce (the name always contains 'sauce') before this rule is reached. Orchestrator must carve a sauce exception (or drop '\bsauce\b' from GLOBAL_EXCLUDE and rely on per-commodity excludes) for this + all the other *-sauce recipe commodities to work. Include 'enchilada' alone is safe once that is fixed.

commodities.label: Fries
commodities.note: \bfries\b covers crinkle/steak/curly/waffle/sweet-potato fries. CONFLICT: GLOBAL_EXCLUDE '\bfrozen\b' pre-drops any ad that says 'frozen fries' - since fries are almost always frozen, the orchestrator likely needs a frozen carve-out for this + frozen-green-peas + frozen-chopped-spinach. Excludes fish-fry breading, stir-fry, onion 'fries', loaded/chili-cheese prepared.

commodities.label: Frozen Chopped Spinach
commodities.note: 'chopped spinach' distinguishes frozen from fresh/baby spinach. Keeps 'frozen' (does NOT exclude it, like frozen-green-peas). CONFLICT: GLOBAL_EXCLUDE '\bfrozen\b' will pre-drop 'frozen chopped spinach' - needs the same frozen carve-out as fries/frozen-green-peas. Excludes spinach-artichoke dip, salad, souffle, creamed spinach.

commodities.label: Frozen Green Peas
commodities.note: Engine GLOBAL_EXCLUDE '\bfrozen\b' will pre-reject any ad string that literally contains 'frozen'; includes deliberately key off 'sweet/green/garden peas' (not the word frozen) so branded bags still match. Parent may need to scope the frozen global for this commodity. \bchick excludes chickpeas.

commodities.label: Ginger
commodities.note: Fresh ginger root sold by the lb. Excludes cut off ginger ale/beer, gingerbread, ginger snaps, ground/powdered ginger spice, candied/pickled forms, and ginger paste (a by-oz product).

commodities.label: Gochujang
commodities.note: Engine GLOBAL_EXCLUDE '\bsauce\b' will pre-reject 'gochujang sauce'; include matches the bare paste name which is how tubs are commonly listed. Parent may need to scope the sauce global here.

commodities.label: Golden Raisins
commodities.note: Golden raisins / sultanas specifically (not dark raisins). \bbran\b blocks raisin bran; excludes yogurt-/chocolate-covered and baked-good uses.

commodities.label: Greek Yogurt
commodities.note: MUST be ordered BEFORE the existing generic 'yogurt' rule (whose include 'yog(?:h)?urt' would otherwise match 'greek yogurt' first). Alternatively add 'greek' to the generic yogurt exclude. FAGE only makes greek so \bfage\b is safe.

commodities.label: Green Beans
commodities.note: Category is Beans & Canned so unit is per-oz (canned/cut green beans, ~14.5oz cans). Engine GLOBAL_EXCLUDE '\bcanned\b' pre-rejects ads with the literal word 'canned', but most list brand+size so still match. A fresh per-lb green bean would normalize off but generally lands out-of-band and is dropped.

commodities.label: Green Cabbage
commodities.note: Broad '\bcabbage\b' include narrowed by excludes for red/napa/savoy/chinese types, slaw/kraut/kimchi prepared forms, cabbage rolls, and corned-beef-and-cabbage meal deals.

commodities.label: Hickory Smoked Bacon
commodities.note: More specific than the existing generic 'bacon' staple. Order this BEFORE generic 'bacon' or it collapses into it (generic include '\bbacon\b' matches first). Global 'wrapped'/'flavored' handle those forms.

commodities.label: Hoisin Sauce
commodities.note: Engine GLOBAL_EXCLUDE '\bsauce\b' pre-rejects 'hoisin sauce'; include matches the bare 'hoisin' token (common on bottles). Parent may need to scope the sauce global for this commodity.

commodities.label: Hominy
commodities.note: Canned white/golden hominy, per-oz (~15-25oz cans). GLOBAL_EXCLUDE '\bcanned\b' pre-rejects the literal word 'canned' but brand+size listings still match. Excludes hominy grits and masa/pozole meal products.

commodities.label: Honey
commodities.note: Pure honey per oz; \bhoney\b anchored + exclude blocks honey-nut cereal, honey mustard/ham/BBQ, honeycrisp/honeydew fall outside word boundary.

commodities.label: Honey Dijon Mustard
commodities.note: Squeeze/jar honey-dijon or honey-mustard condiment; excludes salad dressing, pretzel/chip dips, wing sauce.

commodities.label: Jasmine Rice (Dry)
commodities.note: Brad 2026-08-23: DRY raw jasmine only. Instant is parboiled then dehydrated - it neither cooks nor yields like raw jasmine at the same weight and costs more per oz - and 82 recipes buy against '3.5 cups dry jasmine' at 700 g on this per-oz basis. Ready-to-eat cups and frozen pouches are already caught by the global excludes.

commodities.label: Ketchup
commodities.note: Bottle ketchup/catsup per oz.

commodities.label: Kidney Beans
commodities.note: Canned red kidney beans per oz; excludes chili beans and white-kidney (cannellini) look-alikes.

commodities.label: Light Sour Cream
commodities.note: Reduced-fat (light) sour cream only; include requires the 'light'/'reduced fat' qualifier so it does not steal full-fat sour cream.

commodities.label: Marinara Sauce
commodities.note: Jarred marinara per oz; note: shares 'sauce' with GLOBAL_EXCLUDE \bsauce\b, so the recipe integration must relax that global term for sauce commodities.

commodities.label: Milk
commodities.note: Priced per container (each). Excludes plant milks, flavored/chocolate milk, evaporated/condensed, buttermilk, milk chocolate candy.

commodities.label: Olives
commodities.note: Jar/can/deli olives per oz; excludes olive OIL, olive loaf lunchmeat, Olive Garden.

commodities.label: Paprika
commodities.note: Ground/smoked paprika spice per oz; spice per-oz bands run high. Smoked paprika kept.

commodities.label: Peanut Butter
commodities.note: Jar peanut butter per oz; excludes PB cups, cookies, crackers, bars, cereal, filled snacks.

commodities.label: Pineapple Chunks
commodities.note: Canned pineapple chunks; include gates on 'chunk' so rings/slices/crushed forms don't match. Deliberately does NOT exclude 'juice' broadly - canned pineapple is packed 'in juice' (the real product); only the 'pineapple juice' beverage is rejected. Heads-up: GLOBAL_EXCLUDE currently drops '\bcanned\b' and '\bjuice\b', which the orchestrator must relax for this canned commodity.

commodities.label: Pineapple Juice
commodities.note: Brad 2026-08-23: 100% juice only. 'Juice Drink' is the label wording for a diluted or sweetened blend, normally CHEAPER per oz - so it would win the crown while being the weaker ingredient. 'Cocktail' is already caught by global_exclude.

commodities.label: Poblano Peppers
commodities.note: Fresh poblano chiles sold by weight. Excludes dried/powder/relleno prepared forms.

commodities.label: Potato
commodities.note: Generic fresh potatoes (russet/red/gold/yukon/bagged). Excludes processed forms (chips, tots, fries, instant, hash browns, mashed, salad). Ordering matters: place after the existing russet-potatoes rule so russet items keep their own bucket.

commodities.label: Provolone Cheese
commodities.note: Sliced or deli provolone. Excludes prepared deli subs/sandwiches that name the cheese.

commodities.label: Red Bell Pepper
commodities.note: Fresh red bell pepper, priced each. Requires the word 'bell' (word-anchored 'red') so it never matches red-pepper spice/flakes. Excludes 'roasted' and 'jar' so jarred roasted red peppers fall through to the roasted-red-peppers commodity - keep this rule BEFORE roasted-red-peppers in the array.

commodities.label: Red Wine Vinegar
commodities.note: Excludes red-wine vinaigrette/dressing and other vinegar types (balsamic/white-wine/rice/cider).

commodities.label: Reduced Fat Mozzarella
commodities.note: Reduced-fat shredded mozzarella, including the '2% milk' spelling. Excludes string cheese and fat free. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Roasted Red Peppers
commodities.note: Jarred roasted red peppers (per oz). Excludes hummus/soup/dip/spread/pesto that also say 'roasted red pepper'. Heads-up: GLOBAL_EXCLUDE currently drops '\bsauce\b' - orchestrator must relax it for the sauce/condiment commodities.

commodities.label: Rotini Pasta
commodities.note: Dry rotini pasta. 'rotini' is distinctive; excludes pasta-salad kits and prepared/canned pasta dinners.

commodities.label: Salsa Verde
commodities.note: Jarred salsa verde (tomatillo). Minted 2026-09-19: staple salsa is red salsa (recipe-floor-id-map round 2 rejected the map, 1 of 5 stores agreeing).

commodities.label: Seasoned Black Beans (Canned)
commodities.note: Canned seasoned black beans (Bush's Seasoned Recipe and the like). Relaxes the 'seasoned' global token for this entry ONLY, which is why 2026-08-23's exclude-only entry was left out: the global would have dropped every product it names. Minted 2026-09-19: staple canned-black-beans is plain (round 2 rejected the map).

commodities.label: Sesame Oil
commodities.note: Sesame oil (often toasted); small bottles run high per oz, hence the wide top band. Critical exclude 'seed' so it can't steal the toasted-sesame-seeds commodity.

commodities.label: Shredded Carrots
commodities.note: Bagged fresh shredded carrots, per oz. The recipe carrots entry (whole, per lb) now excludes shred so it cannot take these first. Minted 2026-09-19: staple carrots is whole carrots per lb.

commodities.label: Smoked Paprika
commodities.note: Smoked paprika spice. The recipe paprika entry now excludes smoked, so a recipe that asks for paprika is priced by paprika and one that asks for smoked paprika by this. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Soy Sauce
commodities.note: Soy sauce / tamari / shoyu. Excludes teriyaki and soy-based non-sauce products (soy milk/beans/nuts). Heads-up: GLOBAL_EXCLUDE '\bsauce\b' would currently drop this entirely - orchestrator must relax that exclusion for the sauce commodities.

commodities.label: Sriracha
commodities.note: Sriracha hot chili sauce, the bottle. Excludes sriracha-flavoured mayo, ketchup, snacks and seasonings. Minted 2026-09-19: staple hot-sauce is generic hot sauce.

commodities.label: Sugar-Free BBQ Sauce
commodities.note: Sugar-free / no-sugar-added barbecue sauce. Excludes rubs and multipack resale listings. Minted 2026-09-19: staple bbq-sauce is regular sauce.

commodities.label: Sugar-Free Maple Syrup
commodities.note: Must be sugar-free/zero-sugar; plain full-sugar maple/pancake syrup is a different (excluded) product.

commodities.label: Sweet Chili Sauce
commodities.note: Sweet chili sauce (Thai style). Minted 2026-09-19: staple chili-garlic-sauce is a different condiment.

commodities.label: Swiss Cheese
commodities.note: Swiss cheese, sliced or block, as the snapshot cells were. Excludes spreadable wedges, processed singles and Swiss-Gruyere blends. Minted 2026-09-19: staple sliced-cheese is American singles (round 3 rejected the map).

commodities.label: Toasted Sesame Seeds
commodities.note: Spice-aisle seeds; reject sesame oil, sesame-topped baked goods, and sesame chicken/dishes.

commodities.label: Tomatillos
commodities.note: Fresh produce by the pound; reject canned/jarred tomatillos and salsa verde.

commodities.label: Tomato Sauce
commodities.note: Plain 8/15 oz can; excludes overlap with pasta/spaghetti/marinara/enchilada sauce commodities.

commodities.label: Traditional Pasta Sauce
commodities.note: Jarred red pasta/spaghetti sauce; marinara and alfredo are separate/other commodities and excluded.

commodities.label: Turkey Pepperoni
commodities.note: Sliced turkey pepperoni. Minted 2026-09-19: staple pepperoni is pork/beef pepperoni.

commodities.label: White Mushrooms
commodities.note: Fresh white/button mushrooms; generic 'mushroom' catch with specialty varieties and canned/dried forms excluded.

commodities.label: White Vinegar
commodities.note: Distilled white vinegar is very cheap per oz; 'wine' excludes white/red wine vinegar.

commodities.label: White Wine Vinegar
commodities.note: White wine vinegar. Relaxes the wine token for this entry only, as red-wine-vinegar does. Minted 2026-09-19.

commodities.label: Zero-Sugar Soda (2 L)
commodities.note: Zero-sugar or diet soda in the 2 L bottle (67.6 fl oz), per fl oz. The pack bounds keep 12 oz cans, 1 L and 3 L bottles and 12-packs off the cell (recipe-floor-id-map round 2 rejected soda because 2 L and 12-pack economics differ). Relaxes the soda token for this entry only. Minted 2026-09-19.
